profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Fullstack C# .Net, Appian, Azure
profile.summary:
“… technology is not given. It’s not like the sun or the moon or the stars. It was made by people like us. If it’s not doing for us what we want, we have a right and a responsibility to change it.”—Mike Cooley, Right Livelihood Award Speech, 1981

Result oriented Senior Software Engineer with more than 13 years of expertise in web-based application development from requirement definitions through successful deployments. Highly knowledgeable in operating systems, data architecture, development in both frontend and backend programming languages. Leveraging agile methodology to strengthen test-driven development and change management initiatives.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
•	Currently working on numerous Appian applications used by PCAOB inspectors while they oversee the audit of public companies and SEC registered brokers and dealers, from building new modules from scratch to feature improvements and maintenance of the existing applications.
•	Converted the manual report generation process to automated processes using SSIS packages, C# .NET and SQL server. 
•	Participating in internal and external application security audits.
•	Improve the performance of the applications by identifying areas of improvement, conducting thorough research and analysis to identify solutions, developing, unit testing and deploying the solutions to various lower environments (Dev, QA and UAT) and finally overseeing the deployment to production.
•	Conducting and participating in design, code, test cases/results reviews.
•	Improved the overall knowledge base of the team by creating detailed design documents for existing modules and outlined the business aspects of various modules.
•	Always been a team player and I continue to wear multiple hats such as that of a tester and system administrator on several occasions to ensure that the tasks were completed on-time.
•	Work with System Administrators to troubleshoot any issues related to the applications or deployment packages.
•	Implementing agile development practices per the application requirements for every project.
•	Improving SQL performance of the applications while dealing with large datasets, by optimizing the queries to retrieve data from tables, views, stored procedures, and functions.
•	 Actively participating in sprint ceremonies.
•	Completing trainings on a regular basis to keep up with the fast-changing technologies.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on numerous .NET (Webforms, MVC 5, .NET Core) applications for the Department of Transportation (DoT), from building new applications from scratch to feature improvements and maintenance of the existing applications.
•	Implemented agile development practices per the application requirements for every project
•	Improved the existing applications and re-designed the User-Interface (UI) using HTML, CSS, JQuery, Bootstrap and NodeJS. 
•	Investigated and resolved application functionality related issues.
•	Troubleshooted technical issues and identified modifications needed in existing applications to meet changing user requirements.
•	Analysed data in the application databases and identified data integrity issues with existing and proposed systems and implemented solutions.
•	Assisted with SQL administration in live and test environments.
•	Ensured Section 508 compliance is in place for all web applications.
•	Participated in the Scrum ceremonies and rituals.
•	 Participated and contributed during weekly status meetings and code reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Jira Align · Entity Framework · .NET Framework · Object Oriented Design · ASP.NET MVC · Software Analysis · Problem Solving · Scrum · Project Documentation · Computer Science · Technical Design · User Experience (UX) · Usability Testing · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · ASP.NET Core · Job Scheduling · Design Specifications · ASP.NET Web API · Technical Specs · Communication · Debugging

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed mock website using wireframe (Axure) based on client’s requirements.
- Designed and developed company website from scratch using Drupal 7.x, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS and JQuery. In cooperated SEO for website content to improve company’s online presence.
- Tested website manually and using online tools for ADA compliance, Speed Test, Stress Test, Cross Browser & Cross Device compatibility. 
- Launched the website on Amazon Web Services (AWS)
- Implemented Google Analytics for web analytics.
- Maintaining and updating the websites as required.
- Implementing and customizing SharePoint 2013 for the company.Assisted with data migration from Alfresco to SharePoint, identified users, created groups and creation of workflows based on requirements of various departments within the company.
- Creating workflows to automate company processes using SharePoint Designer 2013 and Visio Professional 2013.
- Designed an ad for FWG Solutions that was published in the Minority Enterprise Advocate (MEA) magazine, Sept-Oct 2015 edition.

- Troubleshooting hardware/software related issues within the company.
